comment: Explicit, dated infrastructure unit prices and capacity assumptions for scripts/metrics/unit_economics.py. Every price records its source and as_of date so FP&A models (e.g. macro.com) can audit or override assumptions without touching code.

hetzner_cpx62.source: Hetzner Cloud published list pricing for CPX62 (16 vCPU, 32 GB / ~30 GiB usable RAM, 640 GB / ~610 GB usable NVMe), US/EU reference rate

hetzner_volume_usd_per_gb_month.source: Hetzner Cloud Volumes published list pricing (EUR 0.044/GB-mo converted at ~1.18 USD/EUR reference rate)

cloudflare_r2_storage_usd_per_gb_month.source: Cloudflare R2 published standard storage pricing ($0.015/GB-month, zero egress)

cloudflare_r2_class_a_usd_per_million.source: Cloudflare R2 published Class A (write/PUT/LIST) operation pricing ($4.50 per million)

cloudflare_r2_class_b_usd_per_million.source: Cloudflare R2 published Class B (read/GET/HEAD) operation pricing ($0.36 per million)

cdn_egress_usd_per_gb.source: Conservative commercial CDN egress reference rate (AWS CloudFront US/EU standard list tier $0.085/GB; Cloudflare Pages/R2 egress is $0.00/GB)

boat_vm_usd_per_hour.source: Observed Boat VM billing in Norn #1533 ($0.07 for 1.89 VM-hours ~= $0.037/VM-hr)

effective_parallel_vms.source: Planning assumption for mean concurrent Boat/runner VMs across a full ci.core wall-clock run; override with actual bundle VM-hour logs when available

cpu_target.source: Production CPU headroom target (50% sustained utilization ceiling)

ram_ceiling.source: Production RAM headroom ceiling (70% max resident tenant allocation, 30% OS/page-cache/headroom)

disk_ceiling.source: Production local NVMe disk headroom ceiling (75% max tenant storage allocation)

ha_replication_factor.source: 3x HA replication factor for production Rivet cell clusters

active_tenant_commits_per_month.source: Reference active SMB/mid-market tenant workload (100k governed commits/month)

peak_to_average_cpu_ratio.source: Burstiness multiplier from monthly average commit rate to peak-hour CPU sizing

hot_cell_retention_months.source: Reference hot-cell retention window on local NVMe for disk-density sizing (12 months of active_tenant_commits_per_month)
